name: cargo-template
description: Payload CMS + TanStack Start on Cloudflare Workers with D1 and R2

scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:database && pnpm run deploy:app
scripts.deploy:app: cross-env APP_ENV=production pnpm run build && cross-env APP_ENV=production varlock-wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:database: pnpm run migrate:remote && wrangler d1 execute D1 --remote --command 'PRAGMA optimize'
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --import=tsx/esm" varlock run -- vite dev
scripts.devsafe: rm -rf dist && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --import=tsx/esm" varlock run -- vite dev
scripts.generate:importmap: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation varlock run -- payload generate:importmap
scripts.generate:types: pnpm run cf-typegen && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation varlock run -- payload generate:types
scripts.migrate: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_SECRET=migration-only varlock run -- payload migrate
scripts.migrate:create: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_SECRET=migration-only varlock run -- payload migrate:create
scripts.migrate:remote: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation APP_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production PAYLOAD_SECRET=migration-only PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=true varlock run -- payload migrate
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --import=tsx/esm" CLOUDFLARE_RUNTIME=true vite preview
scripts.test: pnpm run test:int && pnpm run test:e2e

PAYLOAD_SECRET.description: Generate a random string using `openssl rand -hex 32`
